overclaims: These disclosures contradict the stated company amounts and yield approximately $28.3 billion, rather than $33.44 billion [e1, e2].
checks.note: The proposition leaves out the three company amounts, which the contract assesses separately from the total. The rationale says the disclosures contradict all the stated company amounts, but e1's explanation names only Alphabet as materially disagreeing. The packet itself shows Amazon's $18.945B matches the broader D&A cash-flow adjustment, and there is no Microsoft evidence item. So Amazon and Microsoft differ by measure, which the text never says. Readers would take them as plain errors. Microsoft's $9.0B rests only on derived inputs.
